data.title: 桃乐丝 · 伊甸园的白色迎宾花嫁
data.description: 【伊甸园白色回廊·黄昏】桃乐丝穿着白粉色婚礼长裙站在玫瑰拱门下，粉色长发与白色羽翼被金色光线勾亮；她双手交叠向镜头微微屈膝，完美迎宾笑容里透出只属于自己的期待。
data.action: 玫瑰拱门下收翼屈膝迎宾，完美笑容里露出只属于自己的期待
data.mood: 完美迎宾背后的私人期待
data.promptProse: Dorothy gives a graceful curtsy beneath Eden's rose arch, hands folded over her white-and-pink bridal gown while long pink hair and folded white wings rest behind the veil. Her measured violet-eyed smile opens slightly with personal anticipation. The vertical medium-full view follows the white corridor beyond the arch. Golden sunset through rose-colored glass rims feathers and veil folds, illuminating pearls while rose shadows stretch across the nearby stone floor.
